sections.title: Beyond Climate & EU — World News Highlights

items.title: Syria's president names final 70 lawmakers to new post-Assad parliament
items.description: Fifteen women are appointed, after only six female candidates were selected by regional electoral colleges last October.

items.title: Google faces EU top court ruling on record €4.1 billion fine
items.description: The EU's highest court will rule on Google's appeal against a record antitrust fine, after the tech giant argued the bloc unfairly penalized innovation.

items.title: Digital euro: The plan to Trump-proof the EU's economies
items.description: The EU’s central bank is preparing a digital euro to cut dependence on Visa, Mastercard and Apple Pay. Success hinges on giving consumers an easy-to-use payment system without prompting a flight from bank savings.

items.title: 2 arrested after apparent Empire State Building proposal
items.description: Two people were arrested in Manhattan on Wednesday after conducting what appeared to be a daredevil marriage proposal at the very top of the iconic skyscraper.

items.title: Japan's new joint custody law reshapes divorce debate
items.description: As Japan introduces joint custody, some couples find it easier to part ways. But the reform sparks debate over whether children's interests are truly central in a system still led by parents.
